**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve every source behind combined buying-chain changes**

When one enrichment pass adds or removes buyer/contractor rows supported by multiple documents, this collapses all causal sources to the single `max(...)` record. `record_material_diff()` then stores one field-level event whose before/after payload can contain several changed rows but whose `buying_chain_evidence_id` identifies only that arbitrary document, so project history and `/api/changes` omit the source links for the other changes. Split the changes by supporting document or persist all causal evidence IDs.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Normalize state codes before compact ZIP+4 values**

The fresh uncovered case is an unhyphenated ZIP+4 value: for equivalent claims such as `100 Main Street, Austin, Texas 787011234` and `100 Main St, Austin, TX 787011234`, neither ZIP branch matches, so `state_end` remains at the final token and `TX` is never expanded. The state endpoint therefore reports `UNKNOWN` for one claim or `CONFLICT` for two claims even though only the state spelling differs; recognize the common nine-digit postal form while retaining the complete postal value.
